samples.summary: New table-cell sibling resolution (`siblingsOf`, and `fn(cellBlock, cell.blocks)`) has no test at all
samples.evidence: The diff adds `siblingsOf()` in both editor.ts (~line 1614) and text-editor.ts (~line 2862), plus passes `cell.blocks` from the cell-range, same-cell and table-walk branches of `forEachBlockInSelection`. Subtree detection is entirely driven by which array is handed in, so a wrong array silently re-levels the wrong blocks (e.g. cursor in a cell but siblings resolved to top-level blocks). Nothing exercises it: the new specs in test/view/editor-tab-bullet.test.ts use only flat top-level list items (no `table`/`tableData` fixture anywhere in that file), the new unit test test/model/list-level.test.ts feeds synthetic arrays directly and never goes through the editor, and grep for `siblingsOf` matches only the two src files — no test references it. No test in packages/docs/test indents a list nested inside a table cell.
searchedFor: Grep siblingsOf across repo (only src/view/editor.ts, src/view/text-editor.ts)

samples.summary: TextEditor.handleIndent/handleOutdent (Cmd+] / Cmd+[) were restructured with no test covering that keyboard path
samples.evidence: handleIndent/handleOutdent in text-editor.ts (lines ~2750-2780) were rewritten to delegate list items to applyListLevelChanges and keep only the marginLeft branch. Their keybinding is `case ']'`/`'['` at text-editor.ts:1309-1315. Grep for `key: ']'` / `key: '['` across packages/docs/test returns no matches, so the Cmd+]/Cmd+[ path (including the paragraph marginLeft branch inside TextEditor, which is a separate copy from editor.ts's toolbar indent that IS tested) is unexercised. The shared applyListLevelChanges is covered indirectly via the Tab tests, so the residual risk is the paragraph branch and the ordering inside these two methods.
searchedFor: read editor-tab-bullet.test.ts (only Tab and editor.indent()/outdent() toolbar API)

samples.summary: Text-box coverage asserts only the final state after indent→outdent→indent, so outdent's subtree behaviour is only weakly probed
samples.evidence: The new spec runs `api.indent(); api.outdent(); api.indent();` and asserts a single end state `[1, 2]` (test/view/text-box-editor.test.ts:578-584). No intermediate assertion after `indent()` or `outdent()`, and the level-0 floor / MAX_LIST_LEVEL ceiling refusal in the text-box surface is not asserted at all, so several plausible outdent regressions in this surface would need the composite to disagree to be caught. Asserting the levels after each call (and one floor case) would make the outdent path directly observable rather than inferred.

samples.summary: No test that a subtree-carrying indent/outdent is undone in a single snapshot step
samples.evidence: indent()/outdent() take one `docStore.snapshot()` and now write N blocks (parent plus carried children) per gesture. No new or existing test in test/view/editor-tab-bullet.test.ts or test/model/list-level.test.ts performs an undo after the multi-block indent, so a regression where only part of the subtree is restored would pass CI.

verdict.reason: The table-cell sibling resolution is real and reachable: editor.ts:1612-1621 defines siblingsOf and forEachBlockInSelection passes cell.blocks at editor.ts:1650/1672/1691 (text-editor.ts:2805/2826/2844, siblingsOf at 2863), feeding planListLevelChanges via applyListLevelChanges (editor.ts:1595, reached from editor.indent/outdent at 3571/3587; text-editor.ts:2712 from handleTab/handleIndent). No test exercises the cell branches. editor-tab-bullet.test.ts (read in full) uses only flat top-level list items and has no table fixture; test/model/list-level.test.ts calls planListLevelChanges with hand-built arrays (lines 38-46, 104-116) and never goes through the editor, so it cannot detect a wrong sibling array being handed in. Repo-wide greps for listLevel in all test/spec files, for .indent(/.outdent( in tests (only text-box-editor.test.ts:334/578, editor-tab-bullet.test.ts:337, editor-on-cursor-move.test.ts:234 — all non-cell), for Cmd+] key events (no matches at all), and for Tab keydowns (only editor-tab-bullet.test.ts and header-table-nav.test.ts, whose cells contain paragraphs only and whose Tab test asserts cell navigation, header-table-nav.test.ts:196-206) yield no counterexample. All 114 files under packages/docs/test were enumerated; the only table+list-item overlap is table-renderer.test.ts:309-333 (marker rendering). Blocking under the test-adequacy rubric: a changed, user-visible document-mutating path (indent/outdent of a list nested in a table cell) has no meaningful test, and a wrong array silently re-levels the wrong blocks.
